offer: Instant odgovor na web upit za najam: formular pita prostor, velicinu i struju, i klijent u par minuta dobije preporuku jedinice i ponudu, i u 21h.
hook_line: Placate Google Ads za hitne upite, pozive pratite CallRailom, a tko ispuni formular umjesto da nazove ceka da netko procijeni tonazu.
opener: Richard, quick one. You track ad calls with CallRail, but the rental form goes into Gravity Forms. When a server room overheats at 9pm and someone fills the form instead of calling, how fast does a quote go back?

workflows.why: Web upit se kvalificira (prostor, velicina, struja, trajanje najma) i odmah dobije odgovor i termin, sto im fali iza formulara.
Chat agent koji zna njihove jedinice i pomogne odabrati tonazu, jer to je prvo pitanje svakog upita.

permission_dm: Richard, you are paying for rental ads and tracking the calls, but form enquiries still wait for someone to size the unit. I build the bit that replies in minutes with a recommended unit and quote. Happy to record 90 seconds on how it would look for Air Solutions. Want it?
followup_not_viewed: Richard, following up on the form question. If lead handling sits with someone else at Air Solutions, point me their way and I will stop filling your inbox. Andrew
avoid: Ne nuditi redizajn ni recenzije, vec imaju 500+ recenzija i widget.
Ne govoriti da ne odgovaraju na pozive, imaju 24/7 liniju.
